source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary:
This ability covers every **ORKS** unit of yours that has it. Such a unit may re-roll its **Advance rolls**, and other rules can make it **riled up**, which gives it:

- a 5+ invulnerable save
- **[[ASSAULT]](vsdata:weapon-ability/assault)** on its ranged attacks
- **advance moves** that do not affect whether it is **eligible to declare a charge**

Once per battle, your army may use [War Cry](vsdata:ability/orks.war-cry) to make every **ORKS** unit of yours with this ability riled up.
